How can finance support climate action, ecological integrity, and equitable development without overstating outcomes?
:::

## Questions we examine

- Who receives climate and transition finance, and on what terms?
- How can investments be evaluated for real-world sustainability impacts?
- What financing barriers face low- and emerging-income economies?
